Title: Azure Lab Services—Multiple owners for lab and lab management

Body.Content:
Azure Lab Services now enables multiple owners to manage a lab. In your lab account, add people as owners or contributors to a specific lab. The people added will now be able to see and manage the lab in their view.

Learn more
